name: Notta
desc: Records, transcribes and summarises meetings in 58 languages.
desc_zh: 录制、转写并总结会议，支持 58 种语言。
solves: Produces a searchable transcript and summary of every meeting without assigning a note-taker.
solves_zh: 每场会议自动留下可搜索的转写与总结，不用再指定专人记录。
best_for: Reaching for it when meetings run in mixed languages or nobody owns the notes.
best_for_zh: 会议语言混杂，或没人负责记纪要时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：2026 AI meeting-notes tool roundups。来源：https://www.techjockey.com/reviews/notta-pricing
